title: Flow delegation request
description: What a parent execution sends when it asks another flow to run. An A2A v1.0 Message, ProtoJSON serialised. Internal delegation in A2A shapes, not A2A support.

messageId.description: Identifier of this request, created by the parent.

contextId.description: The delegation tree this call belongs to: the root execution id.

taskId.description: Set only when the request adds a turn to a task that already exists.

role.description: A2A reserves ROLE_USER for the client side of a task, and the parent is the client here.

parts.description: At least one part: the instruction as text, the inputs as data, or both.

part.description: A2A v1.0 part. The member name is the discriminator; there is no kind field.

data.description: Structured inputs for the child flow.

requestMetadata.description: Preloop specifics, namespaced. Closed on purpose: adding a key is an edit to this schema and to docs/guide/flow-delegation-shapes.md in the same change.

preloop.ai/rootExecutionId.description: First execution of the tree. Null when the caller is itself the root.

preloop.ai/flowId.description: The flow being asked to run.

preloop.ai/flowName.description: That flow's name when the call was made, for reading.

preloop.ai/depth.description: Depth the child would run at: the caller's depth plus one.

preloop.ai/consoleUrl.description: Console link to the calling execution.
